intro: Keeper Bel'dugur is a scholarly Forsaken residing deep within the Apothecarium of the Undercity. He serves his people by commissioning expeditions to recover dark tomes and magical artifacts from across Azeroth.

p: Situated among the vats and researchers of the Apothecarium, Keeper Bel'dugur tasks adventurers with retrieving dangerous arcane and occult relics from across Azeroth. Among his most prominent interests is the Book of Ur, a legendary treatise on extra-dimensional beings locked away inside Shadowfang Keep. While many in the Undercity seek magical knowledge to cure or weaponize the condition of the undead, Bel'dugur's curated acquisitions appear tailored toward unearthing ancient, forbidden powers.
